kb-update: 4 CRM monitors flagged false-alarm (monitor-creation bootstrap, not real fires)

n.gaikwad@method.me created 4 new [CRM][P1] error-rate monitors 14:36:24-14:37:07Z (ms-scheduler-api 303750093, method-mobile-notifications-api 303750154, ms-email-api 303750188, notifications 303750212). All picked up by the degraded-mode DD-scan-diff as "new alerts" but none ever crossed their own 5% error-rate threshold -- overall_state_modified in all 4 cases is the monitor's first-evaluation timestamp (6-9s after creation), not a real Alert transition.

Process gap flagged: the degraded-mode scan-diff should filter to overall_state in (Alert, No Data) or exclude monitors created within the poll window, to avoid this false-positive class going forward.

Two incidental findings while investigating (neither caused these alerts, not elevated to their own classification):
- ms-scheduler-api (303750093): bare-text KB match against ki-2026-07-03-ms-scheduler-api-seriesid-negative-recordid. ES confirms that chronic bug IS still active (4 fresh hits) but did NOT bump that KB's occurrence count -- this monitor didn't fire because of it.
- ms-email-api (303750188): 4x real NullReferenceException in EmailMonitoringService.GetEmailMonitoringSnapshotAsync (EmailMonitoringService.cs:83), unguarded null deref. Low volume, worth a look, not urgent.
